diagnostics.message: `module.webhook-github-app:resource.null_resource.update_app` runs a local-exec (`bin/update-app.sh`) that points the GitHub App's webhook at `module.runners.webhook.endpoint`. That endpoint is computed only from `aws_apigatewayv2_api.webhook` (api_endpoint) concatenated with a hardcoded \"webhook\" relative path, so its dependency chain includes the API/Lambda/role but NOT the POST /webhook route. The API Gateway route that actually serves the /webhook path (and the stage/permission that make it reachable and invokable) is not an ancestor of the null_resource. As a result GitHub can be configured with a webhook URL whose route does not exist yet, so the very first (ping) delivery 404s. `null_resource.update_app` should depend on `aws_apigatewayv2_route.webhook`.
